propositions: Verifier step budget exhausts on legitimate criteria validation despite separate runaway guards (tool_calls_limit, loop detection), causing false UNMET verdicts; cost model is story-calibrated without evidence-surface scaling and lacks cross-run cache, forcing re-verification (~10 min/cycle).

Raise budget defaults (steps_per_criterion 8→24, floor_min 48→160, clamp 480→960) and add evidence-surface scaling term (budget = per_criterion×c + child_traversal×direct_children + fixed_overhead) with new VerifyConfig keys, applying to both primary sizing and plan_recovery_pool.

Implement cross-run PASS-verdict cache at .rebar/cache/completion_verdicts/<ticket>/<criterion-hash>.json keyed by criterion-text hash and scoped content fingerprint (git blob SHAs of file_impact paths), seeding valid entries into run-scoped bank at startup with seeded:true flag and omitting them from primary work surface.

Exclude seeded criteria from finalizer judgment such that echo/downgrade/omission by finalizer is replaced by the cached bank record, while same-run non-seeded downgrades remain preserved; invalidate cached entries on fingerprint or criterion-text change (including in-scope file edits), but preserve across unrelated commits.

Thread verify_ref kwarg through verify_completion → CompletionAgentStep to bind fingerprints and verified_ref_sha to the ref's tree state, ensuring cache reuse only at the target ref and preventing illegitimate seeding after HEAD advances.

All defaults raised and formulas updated in test pins (test_completion_budget.py, test_completion_banking.py); budget-only runaway semantics documented; tool_calls_limit and loop detection unchanged; 100% mutation kill rate on changed code paths.
